usedFor: Shopify is where orders and checkouts happen, and Memory stores them through “Create a record” or “Update a record”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a record” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: It keeps each abandoned checkout as a record, which can add a new entry or update an existing one.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify polls on a schedule, so a checkout reaches Memory a little after the customer leaves.
